newsitem.title: UK: Arcadian to raise 15 mln stg in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Arcadian to raise 15 mln stg in rights issue.

text.p: UK hotels operator Arcadian International said it planned a one-for-three rights issue at 45 pence per share to raise 14.9 million stg to finance expansion.

The proceeds will help fund 25 million stg worth of investment, which includes participation in redevelopment of the flagship Great Eastern Hotel, the purchase of the Rookery Hall hotel and development of the city centre Malmaison hotel concept. The company has also secured new banking facilities.
"These far reaching proposals represent a significant landmark in Arcadian's development," chief executive Robert Breare said.
"Most notably they will improve the balance and profile of Arcadian's operations."
